The ultrasound confirms absence of any intrauterine pregnancy tissue, and the falling hCG confirms biological resolution of trophoblastic activity. “Completed abortion” is a distinct clinical category in the WHO/ACOG classification: it follows inevitable or missed abortion and is defined by complete expulsion of all conceptus tissue, with cessation of bleeding/pain and uterine involution.
